summary: Load a protocol-qualified URL in the WebContents through Chromium navigation.

target.notes: Preserve Electron WebContents/Chromium renderer semantics through the ElectronCompat host boundary; do not replace navigation, rendering, printing, or DevTools with ordinary .NET calls.

semantics.completion: promise resolves after did-finish-load and rejects on load failure

tests.name: https load
tests.expected_behavior: navigates renderer and resolves after page finishes loading

tests.name: programmatic navigation event boundary
tests.expected_behavior: will-navigate is not emitted solely for the programmatic loadURL call
